description: How Canton Dev Fund proposals actually move through the Foundation project board, from the recorded column history: the funnel (how many reach each column), median and p90 days in each column, time to decision, time to the first human response, how many open proposals wait on the applicant, the committee, a vote or nobody, bot labels against the board, and steps back. Pass number for one proposal: every stay in a column with the date and who moved it, its waiting state with the reason, first response, votes and steps back. Pass view "flow" for the weekly opened, voting, approved and closed counts and the open backlog. Percentiles are linear interpolation; open proposals are never mixed into completed-stay statistics; every figure carries its n and the board history has known gaps, stated in the answer. Canton-specific.

number.description: A proposal (PR) number: its own history instead of the overview.

view.description: overview (default) or flow (weekly numbers). Ignored when number is given.

name: get_dev_fund_lifecycle
